name: separation-victim
comment: X-28's TARGET. Commands no movement and faces the shooter, so the only thing this
programme moves apart is the shooter's own withdraw step -- a target that also walked
would make the resulting distance a sum of two unknowns.
IT DOES NOT FOLLOW THAT IT STAYS PUT. In p5-separation-02 and -03 the SERVER walked this
body 518 m and 509 m from its spawn while this file commanded nothing (X-71), and after
that the engagement is over whatever the programme says. Read localActor against its own
spawn before trusting any distance in a run of this set.
victim-input-held is X-29's probe and it is deliberately a step that DEMANDS input while
dead: moveZ 1.0 and fire, held for six seconds. If the death path suppressed input the
body neither walks nor shoots, and combat.deathInput records both halves of that window.
The last step exists because of X-29's second half. The respawn edge is raised by the
respawn-window step, and a checkpoint fires at its step's ENTRY, so the respawn-window
capture is taken BEFORE the request is even sent -- which is why no artifact has ever
shown a respawn landing. 'respawned' is the first capture after it.
